description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US（默认值）：英文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

description.zh: 地址池名称，支持对输入的地址池名称进行模糊搜索。
description.en: Address pool name, supports fuzzy search for the entered address pool name.

description.zh:
地址池类型，支持对地址池类型进行精确查询：

- IPv4

- IPv6

- domain
description.en:
Address pool type, supports precise query for address pool types:
- IPv4
- IPv6
- domain

description.zh:
地址池可用状态，支持对地址池可用状态进行精确查询：

- available：可用

- unavailable：不可用
description.en:
Address pool availability status, supporting precise queries for address pool availability:
- available: Available
- unavailable: Unavailable

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
地址池启用状态，支持对地址池启用状态进行精确查询：

- enable：启用状态

- disable：禁用状态
description.en:
Address pool enable status, supports precise query of address pool enable status:
- enable: Enabled status
- disable: Disabled status

description.zh:
地址池健康状态，支持对地址池健康状态精确查询：

ok：正常，地址池引用的所有地址全部可用。

ok_alert：警告，地址池引用的地址部分不可用，但是地址池状态判定为正常。警告状态下，可用的地址池正常解析，不可用的地址池停止解析。

exceptional：异常，地址池引用的地址部分或全部不可用，地址池状态判定为异常。
description.en:
The health state of the address pool. You can enter a health state for exact search. Valid values:

ok: The health state of the address pool is normal and all addresses that are referenced by the address pool are available.

ok_alert: The health state of the address pool is warning and some of the addresses that are referenced by the address pool are unavailable. However, the address pool is deemed normal. In this case, only the available addresses are returned for Domain Name System (DNS) requests.

exceptional: The health state of the address pool is abnormal and some or all of the addresses that are referenced by the address pool are unavailable. In this case, the address pool is deemed abnormal.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: Current page number, starting from 1, default is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20。
description.en: The number of rows per page when paginating queries, with a maximum value of 100 and a default of 20.

description.zh: 地址池备注，支持对输入的备注进行模糊搜索。
description.en: Address pool remarks, supporting fuzzy search for the input remarks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns search-cloud-gtm-address-pools --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --address-pool-name AddressPool-1 --address-pool-type IPv4 --enable-status enable --remark test --health-status ok --available-status available --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns SearchCloudGtmAddressPools --region cn-hangzhou --AddressPoolName 'AddressPool-1' --PageSize 20 --AddressPoolType IPv4 --PageNumber 1 --EnableStatus enable --AvailableStatus available --HealthStatus ok --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000' --Remark test
